parsed_data.job_overview: Support data scientists in exploratory data analysis, predictive modeling, and translating data insights while gaining hands‑on experience with real‑world datasets and MLOps practices.
key_deliverables: Deliver exploratory data analysis reports highlighting actionable insights
Develop and evaluate predictive models for assigned business problems
Produce documented model pipelines and performance dashboards
Contribute to MLOps implementation such as model tracking and automated deployment
required_skills: Ability to read and implement research papers
Strong verbal and written English communication
responsibilities: Formulate and evaluate data hypotheses; perform exploratory data analysis (EDA) to uncover key patterns and trends
Research, implement, and evaluate machine learning, statistical, or NLP algorithms tailored to project requirements
Collaborate with senior team members and business stakeholders to understand domain needs and project objectives
Stay current with emerging research, methodologies, and industry trends in data science
Document experimental workflows, model architectures, and performance metrics clearly
